title: Implement palette picker component
description: Implement the PalettePicker component for the editor. Shows swatches for all available palettes. Clicking a swatch instantly changes the landing page color theme in the preview.
acceptanceCriteria: PalettePicker renders a grid of color swatches
Each swatch shows the palette name and 3-5 preview colors
Current palette is highlighted with a ring/border
Clicking a swatch calls onPaletteChange and the preview updates immediately
Swatches are loaded from the palette JSON files (TASK-40)
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Client component. Props: `currentPaletteId: string, onPaletteChange: (paletteId: string) => void`. Import all palette JSON files from `src/lib/palettes/`. Render a grid of swatches.
Each swatch: 80x60px card with 5 color blocks from the palette (primary, secondary, accent, background, text). Palette name below. Active swatch has a 2px ring in primary color.
On swatch click: call `onPaletteChange(palette.id)`. Parent updates page_data.paletteId. Preview re-renders with new CSS variables applied by applyPalette() (TASK-48).
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify swatches grid renders. Click a different palette and verify the preview colors change.
